objective:
Issue #22 (data side): the Demo workflow will start a scheduled recording once a configured local time has passed, and the snapshot must record when it was planned and whether it started late, so the page can say so (P-7). Extend src/fetch/demo.ts:
1. buildDemoResult reads two new env vars, set by the workflow (coordinator writes the workflow): DEMO_PLANNED_AT (ISO UTC timestamp, the planned start of today's scheduled recording) and DEMO_STARTED_AT (ISO UTC timestamp, when this workflow run started).
   - Both empty or unset (a manual run, or a run from before #22): the result has NO `planned` key at all (not null, not undefined-valued: the key is absent from the written JSON).
   - DEMO_PLANNED_AT set and a valid timestamp, DEMO_STARTED_AT valid: planned = { at: <DEMO_PLANNED_AT normalized with new Date(x).toISOString()>, late: started - planned > 30 minutes } (exactly 30 min is NOT late; 30 min + 1 ms is late; a start before the planned time is not late).
   - DEMO_PLANNED_AT set but not a valid timestamp, or set while DEMO_STARTED_AT is missing/invalid: throw an Error with a plain message naming the variable (the workflow then fails loudly, P-2). DEMO_STARTED_AT set alone (no DEMO_PLANNED_AT) is ignored (manual run).
2. parseDemo keeps `planned` when present and valid ({ at: timestamp string, late: boolean }), omits the key when absent, and throws `Invalid <source>: planned must be { at, late }` when present but malformed (including null). This matters because loadSnapshotDemo carries the day's demo over into later Snapshot runs; a carried-over demo must keep `planned`, since the workflow's gate reads snapshots/<date>.json `.demo.planned` to know a scheduled video already exists today.
3. scripts/demo-result.ts: its console line adds `, planned <at> (late)` or `, planned <at>` when planned is present. No other behaviour change.
Nothing client-facing: no page text (P-1).
contract:
src/types.ts at base (2940cd3) adds to interface Demo: `planned?: { at: string; late: boolean };` (scheduled runs only; at = planned start ISO; late = run started > 30 min after it; absent on manual runs and older snapshots).
Current src/fetch/demo.ts: buildDemoResult(deps: ResultDeps { env, readLog, now }) returns { outcome, recordedAt, version, versionUrl, step, videoUrl, run }; parseDemo(value, source) validates an untrusted Demo and rebuilds the object field by field (so today it would DROP planned); loadSnapshotDemo reads DEMO_RESULT_FILE or carries over the same date's snapshot demo through parseDemo. Tests: test/data/demo.test.ts (env objects injected, no network).
How the workflow will use it (coordinator's change, not yours): a `plan` job computes started_at = run start (date -u +%FT%TZ) and, for scheduled runs, planned_at = DEMO_TIME in DEMO_TZ on today's local date, e.g. 2026-11-18T22:00:00Z for 16:00 America/Chicago; manual runs pass DEMO_STARTED_AT only and DEMO_PLANNED_AT as "" (an unset Actions output arrives as an empty string). The gate skips a scheduled tick when snapshots/<today>.json already has demo.planned.
Gate at base 2940cd3: 272 tests passed, typecheck clean.
